method: Opaque source pixels sampled every two pixels in each registered frame. Broad blue/neutral/green signature masks compare against approved idle frame 0. This is a screening measure, not a semantic garment mask, perceptual color difference or quality score. Pose occlusion and exposure change the mixture. Face/costume identity require visual inspection.

visualAssessments.coverage: All 408 first poses inspected on 12 boards; color screening sampled all 2289 registered frames. Ten flagged drawings inspected enlarged. This is not visual approval of every frame.
